derivation: Frozen questions and oracle criteria only. Negative-transfer guards constrain the accuracy of any assertion made; they do not require restating an unasked distractor value or role. No heldout execution outcomes were inspected.
scope: Required affirmative source-backed answer facts from the frozen oracle catalog. Guard-only collision facts remain correctness and adverse checks, and all storage requirements remain unchanged. Derived arithmetic, unknown values, citation/date conditions and process requirements retain separate checks.

checkpoints.rationale: The question affirmatively requests Systems revenue, quarterly/cumulative/parent profit and CFO appointment. Its instruction not to transfer Holdings figures or people and the initial-person criterion are attribution guards, not requests to restate Holdings profit or director. Correct identification of FICT-MV-A and the Systems/Holdings distinction satisfies the guard without those unasked facts.
checkpoints.guard_interpretation: Do not misattribute the other company/person or transfer its figure/role. Omission of that unasked figure/role alone is not a failed distinction. If the answer discusses it, it must remain accurate and separate; contradiction fails the existing person/entity and adverse checks.

checkpoints.rationale: The question and period-basis-separation criterion explicitly compare Q2 consolidated profit, H1 profit, parent-only profit and Holdings profit. Revenue, CFO appointment and the other person are retained context but not requested facts for this answer. Forecast uncertainty remains a separate answer criterion.

The question and contract-time criterion require the newly announced contract value/signature and planned delivery. Earlier earnings and officer facts are not requested. Publication date, non-recognition and unsupported forecast remain checked by the frozen answer criteria and numeric null requirement.
